description: Ontario publishes an annual series of Environmental Compliance Reports for facilities with regulated wastewater discharges or air emissions. The Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks requires facilities to report instances where approved operating limits have been exceeded. The reports cover industrial sewage, municipal/private sewage and air emissions, with compliance actions, enforcement, penalties and prosecutions. This resource groups the annual subject files of one provider report series. The CUDC inventory lists 2012–2021 components, while the current Ontario package describes recent Excel/CSV tables and archived earlier years. Limitations: actual facility attributes, numeric reporting units and completeness of the retained archive were not established from metadata. Sewage-discharge operating-limit evidence falls within wastewater infrastructure scope; air-emission subjects remain part of the same published series. The primary package states the Open Government Licence–Ontario, differing from CUDC’s generic UK-licence identifier. Specific simulation uses are not stated. Costs and actual payload access remain untested. No related active equivalent was found. No table, ZIP or metadata PDF was fetched.
